# About — Tucker Craig

> About Tucker Craig: software engineer and Davidson College alumnus building a macOS browser, an iOS coding-agent client, local voice-to-text, quota tools, and omalo firmware.

Canonical: https://btuckerc.dev/about

![Tucker Craig](https://btuckerc.dev/avatar-courtyard.jpg)

## Tucker Craig

Software Engineer

Hello, world! I'm Tucker. A lot of what I build starts with something small that bugs me. I wanted a browser with the features I like and none of the usual bloat, so I built angl browser. I wanted to keep track of my AI usage, so I built Pace Bar. I didn't want to keep paying for voice-to-text, so I made my own. I wanted my coding agents with me away from my desk, so now they're on my phone. Even something to help me get the right movie seat. There's a bunch more on my [projects page](https://btuckerc.dev/projects). Feel free to check it out.

Right now I'm building tools for myself across Mac, Windows, and iOS, plus writing firmware for a little Arduino handheld called [omalo](https://btuckerc.dev/projects/omalo). Most problems feel solvable lately if someone just decides to point their tokens at them.

I stream on [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/itux) from time to time. Hoping to do it more soon.

I also sang a cappella in [The Nuances](https://open.spotify.com/track/5CV2w2PIbKouRr2jNKjJIR) at Davidson.

My main site and older web archives live at [tuckercraig.com](https://tuckercraig.com/).
